sloka: त्वयि वीर विपन्ने हि अज्ञान् लाघवान् मया ।मौढ्यम् च मम बाल्यम् च ख्यापितम् स्यात् कपीस्वर ॥४-१२-३४॥
transliteration: tvayi vīra vipanne hi ajñān lāghavān mayā ।mauḍhyam ca mama bālyam ca khyāpitam syāt kapīsvara ॥4-12-34॥

translations.english: 'O lord of monkeys I would have betrayed my foolishness and childishness had I exposed you to danger by my ignorance and thoughtlessness.
